jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

Abhängig von deinem Kenntnisstand und dem jeweiligen Projekt kannst du beispielsweise:

  • dich in Themen der Versicherungswirtschaft einarbeiten, insbesondere in Schaden-, Leistungs-, Vertrags- oder Bestandsprozesse,
  • technologische Entwicklungen auf mögliche Anwendungsfelder in Versicherungsunternehmen untersuchen,
  • bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung von Projektterminen und Workshops unterstützen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Data Science oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.

Das kannst du bei uns entwickeln

  • Geschäftsprozesse systematisch zu erfassen und zu analysieren,

  • Ergebnisse adressatengerecht aufzubereiten,

jobs.title: (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als (Senior) Marketplace Manager verantwortest du unsere Präsenz auf den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen Europas, strategisch wie operativ. Du hast Ownership für Performance, Profitabilität und Markenauftritt deiner Kanäle und entscheidest aktiv mit, wie wir TEVEO auf den Plattformen positionieren.

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marke und Plattform. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit E-Commerce, Operations, Marketing, Finance und externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Community-Spirit auf jedem Marktplatz genauso anfühlt wie in unserem eigenen Shop.

Wichtig: Das ist keine reine Strategie-Rolle. Du bist hands-on unterwegs, packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an und setzt deine Ideen eigenständig um, vom Produktfeed über die Kampagne bis zur SLA-Kennzahl.

Dein Bereich als (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d):
Strategie & Wachstum

  • Du entwickelst unsere Marketplace-Strategie für Europa und setzt sie um: Sortiment, Pricing, Promotions und die Erschließung neuer Marktplätze und Länder.

Account- und Plattformsteuerung

Content, Visibility & Brand Experience

Operations & Data

Partner & Dienstleister

Dein Profil

Deine Stärken die wir in unserem Team brauchen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, E-Commerce, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Commerce- oder Marketplace-Management, idealerweise im Fashion- oder Sportswear-Umfeld; für die Senior-Rolle nachweisliche Verantwortung für einen Marktplatz-Kanal inklusive Umsatzzielen
  • Fundiertes Know-how in Marktplatzprozessen, Fulfillment-Setups und Provisionsstrukturen; Erfahrung mit großen Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen ist ein großes Plus
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä., Looker Studio und Excel/Sheets
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Stärke, unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Gespür für die Balance aus Performance und Brand-Ästhetik
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du arbeitest gern selbst im Tagesgeschäft mit, statt nur zu delegieren, und setzt Dinge schnell und pragmatisch um
  • Verhandlungsstärke und Souveränität im Umgang mit Plattformpartnern und internen Stakeholdern
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Warum wir?

Deine Perspektiven:

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben, die viel Eigeninitiative erfordern
  • Regelmäßige Feedback Gespräche und transparente Kommunikation
  • Zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen

Unsere Benefits:

  • Zukunftssicherheit mit Extras
    Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und baue dir entspannt deine finanzielle Absicherung auf – wir unterstützen dich dabei mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss.
  • Familienfreundlichkeit im Fokus

Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt.
  • Fitness direkt im Haus

Prozesse & Optimierung

Das bringen Du mit

  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis: Du arbeitest Dich schnell in neue Software und digitale Systeme ein und hast Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen.

  • Digitale Affinität: Du organisierst Dich lieber mit digitalen Tools, Aufgabenboards und smarten Workflows als mit dem guten alten Notizblock. 😉

Nice-to-have

Dein Start bei IMMO PICTURES

Was Dich erwartet

  • Ein freundliches, motiviertes Team: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und ziehen gemeinsam an einem Strang.

Passt Du zu uns?

Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur seine To-do-Liste abarbeitet.

Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Freude daran hat, Dinge am Laufen zu halten.

Uns ist nicht nur wichtig, was Du kannst, sondern vor allem, wer Du bist.

Wenn Du Dich darin wiedererkennst und Lust hast, in einem modernen, wachsenden Unternehmen eine zentrale Rolle zu übernehmen, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! 😊

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.

  • Fluent English required

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable, and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

You will own Focused Energy's permitting and regulatory pathway across our regulated technical facilities, from early feasibility through construction, commissioning, and handover to Operations. You will build and run the integrated permitting strategy under the direction of the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and act as our primary contact with competent German authorities. Your work will ensure regulatory requirements shape design, procurement, and construction decisions, with a particular focus on the Biblis site transition and the evolving German fusion regulatory framework.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain the integrated permitting strategy, including authority mapping, submission schedules, permit and conditions registers, and regulatory-risk forecasts.

  • Lead coordinated engagement with municipal, district, Hessian state, and federal authorities, aligning submissions and commitments with the approved project strategy.

  • Own permitting coordination for the Biblis nuclear-site transition, including RWE decommissioning interfaces, existing licences, radiation-protection arrangements, and handover evidence.

  • Coordinate application readiness with Engineering, architects, fire-safety and structural specialists, and the Prüfstatiker, and track reviews to closure.

  • Monitor the German fusion legal framework and translate permit conditions and regulatory changes into project requirements, schedules, and risk responses.

  • Escalate material risks and options to the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and hand ongoing permit obligations to Operations.

Must-Haves

  • Strong experience in German construction and public permitting, including building applications, authority consultations, and partial approvals.

  • Working knowledge of Hessian procedures and the Hessische Bauordnung.

  • Working knowledge of radiation-protection licensing and nuclear-site interfaces.

  • Experience coordinating fire-safety and structural-checking processes with specialists and consultants.

  • Ability to explain regulatory risk and options clearly to non-specialists, including project managers and agency counterparts.

  • Fluent German and English, both written and spoken.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Tritium or comparable regulated-facility experience.

  • Experience with multi-agency permitting for novel or regulated technical facilities.

  • Experience building reusable permitting playbooks or standards across projects.

jobs.description:
About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.


The Role

We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input.

We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows.

You'll spend most of your time advancing our core context-learning library and the harness that powers our agents across every customer. The work spans continuous learning, context engineering, agent orchestration, and evaluation. You'll contribute to our knowledge benchmarks and to the self-improving capabilities of the harness.


What You'll Do

  • Build and extend our core context-learning library, turning customer-informed problems into reusable platform capabilities.

  • Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production.

  • Build agentic features for knowledge management: agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously.

  • Build continuous learning loops that use human corrections and production outcomes to find knowledge gaps, detect changed procedures, and improve prompts and instructions.

  • Build reliability and confidence systems: evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate and when to escalate to a human.

  • Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration.

  • Contribute to the direction of our AI strategy and product capabilities.


What We’re Looking For

  • You've built a complex, production LLM system with real depth: multiple layers of engineering decisions you can walk through, including what changed after real users arrived.

  • You have practical depth in one or more of context engineering, retrieval, agent orchestration, memory, evaluation, or learning from feedback.

  • You have experimental judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a testable hypothesis, set a baseline, and tell a real improvement from noise.

  • You're excited by open-ended problems where the solution might not exist yet.

  • You can navigate between research papers and production code with equal comfort.

  • You're a strong communicator who can explain your work to teammates and customers.

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience.

 

Don’t meet all of the above traits? We’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for exceptional people with unique skills and interests, and we know that great people have different backgrounds and skillsets.

jobs.title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle.

You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

Responsibilities

Functional and system testing

  • Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

  • Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations.

  • Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports.

  • Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health.

  • Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers.

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing.

Verification tracking

  • Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design.

  • Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign.

  • Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones.

  • Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance.

GSE and test infrastructure

  • Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes.

  • Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor.

  • Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware.

Integration and campaign support

  • Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures.

  • Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign.

  • Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing.

  • Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions.

Requirements

  • Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience.

  • Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems.

  • Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components.

  • Working knowledge of satellite subsystems: EPS, OBC/C&DH, ADCS, communications (TT&C and payload RF), propulsion, thermal, structures and payloads.

  • Experience using and setting up GSE, including EGSE, checkout systems and RF test equipment.

  • Experience with requirements verification and maintaining a verification matrix through to close-out.

  • Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, spectrum analysers, logic analysers.

  • Familiarity with common spacecraft interfaces and protocols (e.g. CAN, I2C, SPI, RS-422, SpaceWire, CCSDS).

  • Clear technical writing for procedures, test reports and NCRs.

Desirables

  • End-to-end involvement in at least one satellite mission that reached launch.

  • Test automation and scripting in Python or similar, and experience with spacecraft control or checkout software (e.g. OpenC3/COSMOS, Yamcs, SCOS-2000).

  • Experience planning or supporting environmental test campaigns (vibration, TVAC, EMC).

  • Knowledge of ECSS standards (e.g. ECSS-E-ST-10-02 Verification, ECSS-E-ST-10-03 Testing) or NASA equivalents.

  • Requirements management tools (e.g. DOORS, Jama, Polarion, Valispace).

  • Launch campaign experience at a launch site.

  • Cleanroom and ESD-certified flight hardware handling.

  • Eligibility for UK security clearance, or the ability to obtain it, if required by the programme.

Personal attributes

  • Takes ownership: drives tests and verification to close-out without waiting to be asked.

  • Methodical and detail-focused, with a strong sense of safety and quality around flight hardware.

  • Calm, structured problem-solver when anomalies appear under schedule pressure.

  • Communicates clearly across disciplines, from subsystem engineers to programme managers and customers.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced SmallSat environment, balancing rigour with pace.

  • Willing to work flexibly during test and launch campaigns, including occasional travel.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As an EMEA Public Sector Deployment Strategist, you will own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of public sector customers across the region, including law enforcement agencies, regulators, and government teams working some of the most complex cases in crypto-related crime. You will own onboarding, adoption, outcomes and the relationship across all TRM products, including Ardence, our newest and fastest-moving product. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts. You will define what success looks like for each customer, prove it with usage and outcomes, and enable the renewals and expansion that follow alongside our Account Directors.

The impact you will have:

  • Onboard and activate your EMEA Public Sector accounts across all TRM products, with a clear onboarding path and measurable hands-on-keyboard usage for every account in your portfolio

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts — compressing hours of reporting prep into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio — hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics — and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made

  • Develop new use cases with investigators and analysts that deepen usage across TRM products, including Ardence, and feed what you learn back into onboarding and enablement for the wider team

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at public sector agencies and regulators across EMEA — building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner

  • Partner with ADs, who own the commercial motion, to enable renewals and expansion: bring account health, adoption evidence, and a structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract, and take accountability for the GRR and NRR outcomes that adoption drives

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product — synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap

  • Work as one team with EMEA colleagues across languages and time zones, sharing the playbooks, workflows, and account plans that work so coverage is consistent across the region

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in customer success, deployment, or post-sale roles with proven accountability for GRR, NRR, and adoption outcomes — you have the track record, not just the title

  • Domain credibility in law enforcement, public sector, cyber, national security, financial crime, or blockchain intelligence — you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you have worked in fast-changing product environments, can ship a working v1 without waiting for a perfect playbook, and can point to the specific outcomes it drove; Ardence is still evolving and your accounts may shift as it matures

  • Production AI fluency — you have built real, repeatable AI workflows (not just experiments) that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and have measurable results; you can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop

  • High level of independence — you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers

  • Strong executive presence — you can run a QBR with a senior government or public sector stakeholder and command the room through substance, not just polish

  • Based in the UK or Europe and comfortable working with customers across EMEA; additional European languages are a plus

About the Team:

  • The EMEA Public Sector team supports law enforcement, government, and regulatory customers working on complex cases involving crypto-related financial crime, cyber threats, and national security risks

  • You will join the EMEA Deployment Strategy team, which covers the region by geography and language (DACH and Eastern Europe, the UK, and SPLATAM), alongside Customer Experience. This is a net-new seat that adds coverage across our accounts, with high autonomy and meaningful influence on how we serve the region

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant — async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions

  • You will work directly with the Head of EMEA Deployment Strategy and the Head of Customer Success, with close day-to-day collaboration with the AD team and Product

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members may observe different timezones. However, most of the team will overlap between the hours of 7am-5:00 pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • Our Customer success Team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly Customer Syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with our customers. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • Moves fast and iterates — v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you have met every account in your portfolio and shipped a working onboarding and adoption plan for your first 2–3 accounts — not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction — getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook

  • Within 60 days, you identify the highest-impact use case or adoption play for your portfolio — presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on what to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

jobs.title: Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer to join our Digital Security team, and make security a built-in quality of everything we ship across the XTM platform (OpenCTI, OpenAEV, XTM One, XTM Hub). You'll work closely with the R&D team: the VP, Staff and Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, Product Owners and the Product Manager. You'll help keep our open source and enterprise products trustworthy for the 6,000+ organizations that defend themselves with them.

This is not a solo audit role. As a Staff engineer, you advise the CISO on product security and turn their strategy into day-to-day practice in the product teams. You lead security as a cross-cutting concern, and coach engineers so they own security in their own scope. And of course, you still code: critical security fixes, PR reviews, pair programming and the shared security components that make the secure path the easy one.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

  • Advise the CISO on product security strategy across the XTM platform, and lead its operational implementation in the product teams: turn priorities into concrete actions, and track security technical pains to resolution.

  • Lead threat modeling and security reviews in feature refinements with Product Owners: authentication and RBAC, multi-tenancy, connectors, the GraphQL API, and AI and agent features.

  • Ensure the security quality of the stack through critical PRs, fixes and code reviews, and build shared, secure-by-default components (authorization, secrets, safe outbound calls, input handling).

  • Drive secure SDLC and supply chain tooling in CI (SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning, Renovate, Snyk, SBOMs, signed releases), tuned so teams trust the results.

  • Run product vulnerability management: intake from the open source community, researchers and bug bounty, coordinated disclosure, CVEs and advisories, remediation SLAs, and the product side of security incidents.

  • Mentor engineers and grow security champions through pairing, workshops and continuous feedback. Document security architecture decisions so they stay consistent across teams.

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

  • Reports to: the CISO, as part of the Digital Security team.

  • Key collaborators: the R&D team, including Staff and Principal Engineers and Engineering Managers across the product teams, and Product Owners during refinements, Platform Engineering on infrastructure, compliance (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, FedRamp) and incidents, and Customer Success on customer security questions and pentest findings.

  • Community: the OpenCTI and OpenAEV open source contributors and the security researchers who report vulnerabilities to us.

  • Mentorship: no direct reports. You'll act as the security technical reference and mentor for engineers across all teams, and grow a network of security champions.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in cybersecurity

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Master degreee in computer science and or cybersecurity with 8+ years of experience in software engineering and application or product security, including at least 3 years as the security technical reference for a SaaS or enterprise product

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment

  • Strong engineering and security skills: you write production code fluently in at least two of Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Rust, and you know web and API security in depth (GraphQL, OIDC/SAML, RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, SSRF, injection), CI/CD security tooling, and container and Kubernetes security

  • A track record of influence without authority: you led a cross-team security initiative, coached engineers, and got standards adopted with pragmatism and clear priorities

  • Autonomy, ownership, and team spirit

  • Bonus: AI and LLM security (prompt injection, agent permissions), open source contributions or published CVEs, bug bounty program experience, knowledge of STIX 2.1 / MITRE ATT&CK or hands-on use of OpenCTI or OpenAEV

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

jobs.title: Head of Social
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, the Head of Social will be responsible for defining and driving TALA’s organic social strategy and growth agenda across our key social channels.

You will lead our social team, setting the strategic direction, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring our social channels build brand awareness, cultural relevance, community and channel growth. You will balance creativity with data and commercial thinking, ensuring we are not just creating content, but building a social presence that drives the business forward.

You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, Influencer, PR, Product and Ecommerce teams, ensuring social is connected to the wider marketing strategy and that TALA continues to be ahead of the conversation.

We’re looking for a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable setting the direction, managing a team and getting into the details when needed.

Tasks

Day to day this looks like:

  • Social Strategy: Own and evolve TALA’s organic social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, with oversight of Pinterest and LinkedIn, setting clear objectives, channel roles, audiences, content pillars and KPIs.
  • Growth Strategy: Identify opportunities to grow TALA’s social audience, reach and relevance, developing strategies to increase awareness, engagement and community.
  • Planning & Prioritisation: Own the social planning process and ensure the calendar is driven by clear business, brand, product and customer priorities. Make clear recommendations on where the team should focus time, resources and investment.
  • Content Strategy: Set the strategic direction for the content we create, identifying the formats, stories, behaviours and cultural moments that will help TALA grow. Provide clear strategic direction and briefs to the content creators within the team, ensuring content is distinctive, relevant, engaging and effective against our KPIs.
  • Engineer Virality: Think beyond existing content formats to identify opportunities to create stop-and-look moments that capture attention and drive conversation. Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel.
  • Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth.
  • Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches.
  • Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Turn data into clear insights and recommendations, using performance to continuously improve our strategy.
  • Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Ensure the team understands not just what they are creating, but why and what it needs to achieve.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy.
  • Channel Health: Oversee the overall health and performance of TALA’s social channels, ensuring content is consistent, on-brand and delivering against agreed objectives. You will provide strategic direction while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution.
  • Reporting: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting against social KPIs, going beyond performance reporting to provide clear insights, recommendations and actions for the wider business.
  • Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy
  • Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience.
  • Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets.

Requirements

You should:

  • Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand.
  • Proven track record of working closely with a Creative team.
  • Be highly collaborative with key stakeholders including Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce.
  • Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach.
  • Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth.
  • Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn.
  • Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel.
  • Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts.
  • Have experience managing and fostering development across a team, with the ability to set direction, inspire creativity and create a high-performing team culture.
  • Be an excellent cross-functional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and multiple teams.
  • Be highly organised and an excellent project manager, able to bring clarity and structure to a fast-moving environment.
  • Be comfortable working in a start-up environment: working lean, moving quickly and finding solutions with available resources.
  • Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required.
  • Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth.
  • Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth.

Benefits

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Very generous employee discount after probation period
  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

About us:

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

Start date: Immediately

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Support FIU scalability by designing processes and monitoring strategies that enable expansion into new products, regions, and increased transaction volumes

  • 5+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or FIU operations, with deep knowledge of transaction monitoring frameworks, suspicious activity detection, and regulatory expectations under BSA/AML regimes

  • 3+ years of experience designing, testing, and tuning transaction monitoring rules, including threshold optimization, scenario design, and alert reduction strategies

  • 3+ years of experience working with transaction monitoring systems and compliance tooling, including case management platforms, monitoring infrastructure, and investigative workflows

  • Experience working in a regulated financial institution, preferably one licensed to operate in the EU, UK, and/or United States

  • Experience driving process optimization or automation initiatives within compliance or financial crime programs to improve operational efficiency and scalability
